reviews.title: Best all around case hands down!
reviews.comment: First: I ain’t a fanboy to Corsair or any company. I buy the best product IMO in that category. 4 yrs ago when I first built my pc it was the Meshify C case. But today  it’s the Corsair 4000D case. I recently upgraded my pc and had to buy a whole new set of core components meaning I needed a new case. I’ve always stuck with black cases and preferred them. But this time I thought I’d try something different. And after looking at MANY reviews this one seemed like it was the best white case overall. As they didn’t skimp on the little things like making only things u can see white and the rest black to save costs. They actually gave a crap which is hard to find for a lot of companies. 2nd: Next thing important to me was looks I liked the meshify c case but idk I didn’t like the newer model it just looked strange to me. But this one looked sick as crap!! I liked the grill front and how it still had mesh for airflow but didn’t look strange like the meshify now does to me. It looks well designed and still functional which is what I really wanted in a new case. 3rd: Case is well priced and if u get the RGB fans option it’s still well priced. I needed new fans anyway as I only had 2 noctua fans that were worth bringing over. So keeping the front 3 as rgb and the output fans as good airflow noctua ones it was hard to pass up. 4th: I needed a case that could fit my new 7900xt GPU. Which is 13.6 in long. It fit with a little room left. With that being my final Requirement I decided to pull the trigger. Conclusion: Overall I highly recommend the case it’s so pretty with its deep white color that won’t chip or fade overtime. Plus it hides DUST really well which was also a nice change from my old black case. Only thing I’d say is maybe lower the price a little and add a bit more cable management space in the back. I always like pointing out those two things even if atm it’s fine for me. Just nice to have them lower the price and add more cable managing space. For future models. :)
reviews.author: TheReal1st

reviews.title: Great cases for custom builds
reviews.comment: My son built his own, my husband's, and even my gaming PC. This gaming case has so far been a life saver for all of us! My husband and son have the black versions, but I got white to match my pink/white gaming setup. Our house can get a little dusty with having a homestead with chickens, and cats in the house. But this case has not been a dust magnet, which was a blessing. Everything has been very high quality - nothing threatened to snap nor felt fragile during our builds. It was very easy to set up, and of course put cute stickers on. The cable management was NO problem, which was one thing we'd initially worried about. We do have little rolling stands under them for ease of movement if we switch up our gaming setup and to help prevent dust damage. All in all, we'll  likely stick with these towers in the future when we upgrade.
reviews.author: Kat

reviews.title: Corsair iCUE 4000D RGB Airflow Mid-Tower Case – My Favorite Case Yet
reviews.comment: I’ve been building PCs for decades, and the Corsair iCUE 4000D RGB Airflow Mid-Tower Case in True White is hands-down one of my favorite cases to date.  This case is a dream to work with. The Corsair RapidRoute Cable Management System made cable organization a breeze, keeping my build clean and tidy. The high-airflow design, paired with the three included AF120 RGB Elite fans, keeps my components (including my Intel Core Ultra 2) cool even during heavy workloads. The fans are quiet and the iCUE Lighting Node PRO controller adds vibrant, customizable RGB that looks stunning in the white chassis.  The build quality is top-notch, with plenty of space for my components and easy access for upgrades. The True White finish is sleek and elevates my setup’s aesthetic. Absolutely no complaints—this case nails functionality, airflow, and style. 5 stars, and I’ll update if anything changes over time. Highly recommend for any PC builder!
reviews.author: Bn321

reviews.title: Excellent case with ideal airflow.
reviews.comment: Bought this case for a new build after getting a PNY 4090. The new 4090's are massive cards however they fit nicely in this case. The case came with three fans for intake however I added a Corsair slim 120 exhaust fan in the rear. I did use a Corsair AIO CPU cooler for my i9 13th gen CPU which I mounted on the top of the case, which mounted without issue. The AIO came with two fans for exhaust. I don't overclock and with that in mind, my CPU/GPU temps stay well within normal ranges while gaming at 4k. The three front fans that the case came with are a bit loud but not loud to the point where I would wear a headset while gaming. The wires are easy to manage in this case, so your build can look clean while allowing excellent air flow. The case also comes with plenty of hardware. I have no real negatives to say about this case.
reviews.author: OnPoint

reviews.title: Corsair 4000D
reviews.comment: Very good pc gaming case and for the price it is worth it. Comes with 3 rgb fans and this model of the case has great airflow. I built my pc in the case and I would always recommend Corsair products.
